test_case.test_name: Power status (GPIO) — retained controlled review-layer procedure
test_case.purpose: Verify that the platform GPIO power-status interface distinguishes a running host from an off host, reporting the documented `Good / ON` indication when powered and the documented low indication after an approved power-off.
required_package: SUT/BMC identity and authoritative location/owner/version/hash of `/usr/bin/powerctrl.sh`
Meaning of `power_status`, named GPIO/rail/signal, polarity and exact ON/off output grammar
Secure access path that remains available after host-off and its authentication/host-key policy
Approved host power-off mechanism, idle/workload/data-safety gate and independent rail/chassis observer
State-transition timeout/debounce/sample policy and treatment of transient or unknown outputs
Separately approved power-on/recovery path, boot timeout and post-recovery health oracle
test_case.test_command: Identify whether `powerctrl.sh` runs on the BMC, host or service controller and map its `power_status` output to a named GPIO/rail/chassis state; establish secure console access and independent BMC/rail telemetry; capture the ON-state command output while the OS is idle; obtain approval and use the documented external power-off mechanism once; from the surviving approved domain capture the same command in the off state; compare both outputs with independent state evidence; separately restore and verify host health.
